newsitem.title: USA: POOL ENERGY SETS EXPANDED FINANCING.
newsitem.headline: POOL ENERGY SETS EXPANDED FINANCING.

text.p: Pool Energy Services Co said Friday it received a commitment letter from SBC Warburg Inc covering a three-year $130 million unsecured revolving credit facility to replace the company's existing $40 million bank line of credit.
It said the facility, which is subject to the negotiation of a definitive agreement, is expected to close in September.
The company said it intends to use the facility to repay about $17 million of existing debt and make additional acquisitions and capital expenditures from time to time.

"The $130 million revolving credit facility will provide the company flexibility in addressing both near-term and future financing needs as we continue to implement our growth strategies," said Jim Jongebloed, chief executive officer.

In July 1997, the company noted, it announced agreements to acquire a West Texas well-servicing company and to construct a new offshore platform rig for the Gulf of Mexico, and today it announced a jackup rig purchase in the Gulf of Mexico and major rig refurbishments in Alaska.
This "enhances our ability to fund the cost of these pending transactions, estimated to be $76 million, as well as additional projects in 1997 and beyond," Jongebloed said.
